items.question: HOW DO REVISIONS WORK?
items.answer: We offer unlimited iterations during the design and initial edit phase until you are 100% satisfied with the final outcome.

items.question: WHAT IS THE TYPICAL TURNAROUND?
items.answer: Standard turnaround is 48-72 hours. Priority 24-hour deliveries are available upon request for retainer clients.

items.question: DO I GET THE RAW SOURCE FILES?
items.answer: YES. UNLIKE OTHER AGENCIES, WE PROVIDE FULL SOURCE FILES (.PRPROJ, .AEP, .BLEND, ETC.) UPON COMPLETION AT NO EXTRA COST. YOUR ASSETS ARE YOURS.

items.question: HOW DOES PAYMENT WORK?
items.answer: 50% upfront to initiate the project, and 50% upon final delivery and client sign-off.

items.question: DO YOU OFFER BULK DISCOUNTS?
items.answer: Yes! We offer customized retainer and multi-video volume packages with up to 30% savings for monthly deliverables.

about.name: I'm Hussnain
about.bio: I'm Hussnain, a passionate motion designer with over 3 years of experience crafting high-impact visuals for creators and brands worldwide. I specialize in video editing, motion graphics, and thumbnail design that converts viewers into fans.

faq.question: What is your turnaround time?
faq.answer: Usually 2-3 business days per video depending on the complexity of the project and motion graphics required.

faq.question: What software do you use?
faq.answer: I primarily work in Premiere Pro and After Effects for precise editing and complex motion graphic workflows.

faq.question: Do you offer revisions?
faq.answer: Yes, all packages include up to 2 rounds of revisions to ensure the final product perfectly matches your vision.

faq.question: How do we communicate?
faq.answer: I prefer Slack or email for daily communication, and we can hop on a Zoom call for project onboarding.
